reason: RFC-220 makes coveringness a plan type built at the access path, so plan RENDERING changes across the corpus: a Fetch wrapper collapses where the merge rule can remove it, and scans acquire a COVERING marker. Rows are unchanged. The drift also concealed a real regression - 183 scenarios lost a correlated EQUALITY index probe on a join inner (quadratic per outer row) because collectScanPlanCorrelations (planner.go:1442) recursed through GetChildren() past a covering plan that holds its index scan as a field. That is fixed in this change; cmd/factory-plan-census now reports 0 for every regression class over the same 7000 scenarios. Per RETIREMENT_LEDGER.md a re-bless erases its own motive, so the classify output is recorded in the commit message.
